inspiration: Damage numbers as a sprite font: a small digit sheet through a TextMesh Pro sprite material, and a separate bubble-shaped sprite for critical hits (Resources/Fonts/DamageSprite.png, crit_baloon.png; Resources/Prefabs/Damage.prefab). Keep the separate crit shape; change the bubble and digit rig.

One effect shader with exposed blend, cull and depth-write options, so one material setup covers additive and alpha effects (Resources/Shaders/Ragnarok/RagnarokEffectShader.shader lines 7-10, 26-30). Copy the approach, write our own shader.
A short one-shot drop clip at 60 fps, not looped (Resources/Animations/ItemDrop.anim, m_SampleRate line 55, m_LoopTime line 80). Template for loot pickup feedback.
A warp burst from one 64x64 soft particle plus a particle prefab (Resources/Sprites/warp_particle.png; Resources/Prefabs/PortalParticles.prefab). Keep single-texture bursts; change the silhouette.
Time-of-day water from separate daytime and night gradient strips plus a normal map (Standard Assets water Textures folder). Generic technique; re-author our own gradient.
Id-keyed class x weapon matrix driving combat options (Assets/AddressableAssets/DataTables/WeaponActions.json). Structure only, useful for our class-weapon table.
